place.raw: Town Point, Provence, Nova Scotia, Canada.

notes: DEATH PLACE/SPOUSE LIKELY ANACHRONISTIC (research 2026-07-03): the tree records her d. 1774 at "Town Point," Nova Scotia, as wife of "Cornelius Hierlihy Lt. Col." — but Town Point (near Antigonish) was not settled until Lt. Col. Timothy Hierlihy (1734-1797) landed his disbanded Loyalist corps there on 12 May 1784, a decade after her recorded death (Wikipedia "Timothy Hierlihy"; imagineantigonish.ca). Timothy Hierlihy's documented wife was Elizabeth Wetmore, not Mary Monahan; "Cornelius Hierlihy" is elsewhere named (charlottetaylor.ca) only as Timothy's probable father, an earlier, undocumented-in-Nova-Scotia generation. Treat this death place/date and the spouse's identity/rank as likely legend-grade pending a primary source.
